B_base.note: Reassessed to market value (no Prop 19 exclusion)

A_no_prop19.note: Reassessed to market value (no Prop 19 exclusion)

S1.name: Live in A, keep B as a 3-unit rental
S1.description: Heir moves into Property A within 1 year (Prop 19 exclusion). Property B is fully reassessed; the vacant unit is rented at market.

S2.name: Live in A, sell B at inheritance and invest
S2.description: Heir moves into A; B is sold shortly after death (stepped-up basis, little or no capital-gains tax) and the net proceeds are invested.

S3.name: Live in B's vacant unit, rent A at market
S3.description: Heir occupies the vacant unit of B; both properties are reassessed to market value (A is no longer anyone's principal residence).

S4.name: Live in B's vacant unit, sell A and invest
S4.description: Heir occupies the vacant unit; A is sold at inheritance and invested.

S5.name: Keep both as rentals, live elsewhere
S5.description: Both properties reassessed to market; heir rents housing elsewhere.

S6.name: Sell both at inheritance, invest, rent elsewhere
S6.description: Both sold after death using the stepped-up basis; all proceeds invested; heir rents housing elsewhere.
